title: PID Control Systems: From Feedback Error to Practical Tuning
subject: Controls and Mechatronics
description: Build a complete PID control model from feedback error through term behavior, performance measurement, tuning, windup protection, filtering, and digital implementation.
outcomes: Explain proportional, integral, and derivative contributions
Interpret rise time, overshoot, settling, and steady-state error
Tune and implement a PID loop with practical safeguards
